summary: Democrats won both houses of Congress and Wall St surged (Dow +3.0%, S&P +1.6%, Nasdaq +1.4%, Russell +1.6%) while oil crashed ~8% on Iran peace hopes and gold jumped 3.3%; the dollar hit a 5-week low and yields fell. AI/data-centre stocks lagged on regulation fears, sinking the Nikkei 3% Wednesday.

ES.why: S&P +1.6% as Democrats took Congress (gridlock = fewer policy shocks) and oil crashed 8%; VIX -20%; funds mid-range (35th pct).
ES.risk: Oil spikes again on Iran headlines or yields jump on a hot jobs/ISM read.

NQ.why: Nasdaq +1.4% lagged the Dow as AI/data-centre stocks fell on regulation fears, and funds are crowded long (94th pct).
NQ.risk: Tech leads a clean follow-through higher, or AI names drop and trigger a crowded-long unwind.

YM.why: Dow +3.0%, best day since April 2025, on the midterm result and plunging oil; broad buying in consumer and healthcare.
YM.risk: A sharp oil rebound or a hawkish Fed repricing of the December hike.

RTY.why: Russell +1.6% with lower yields and cheap oil helping domestic small caps; no crowded positioning data against it.
RTY.risk: Yields climb back toward recent highs.

NKD.why: Nikkei fell 3% Wednesday as AI stocks were hit by US data-centre scrutiny; Wall St rally helps, but chip-heavy index and a firmer yen cut against it.
NKD.risk: Japanese chip stocks bounce hard with US futures, or the AI selloff deepens.

6E.why: The dollar slipped after the election and EUR/USD rose ~0.3% as US yields eased.
6E.risk: US data beat lifts Fed-hike odds and the dollar.

6J.why: Dollar and US yields fell while the BOJ is seen hiking in December; funds are neutral (74th pct), so room either way.
6J.risk: Risk-on carry trades weaken the yen again, or US yields rebound.

6B.why: Pound hit a seven-week high near $1.35 as the dollar fell to a 5-week low.
6B.risk: A dovish BoE surprise or broad dollar rebound.

6A.why: RBA hiked to 4.85% Tuesday and the risk-on mood plus softer dollar lifted AUD (~0.70).
6A.risk: Risk-off reversal or a dollar rebound.

ZN.why: Treasuries rallied (10y ~4.89%, yields -3 to -7bp) as gridlock limits deficit spending and the oil crash eases inflation fears.
ZN.risk: Strong jobs data push December Fed-hike odds (~77%) higher.

GC.why: Gold +3.3% (best day since Aug) back above $4,000 on a weaker dollar and lower yields; funds lean short (24th pct), leaving room to buy.
GC.risk: Dollar rebounds hard or Fed-hike odds jump on strong data.

CL.why: Oil crashed ~8% (WTI ~$88) on hopes Qatar mediation ends the US-Iran war; but funds are near-crowded short (13th pct), so squeezes likely.
CL.risk: Talks stall or new strikes revive the war premium; short squeeze risk.
